scripts.build:site: npm run prepare:legacy-assets && node scripts/validate-content.mjs && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/validate-build.mjs
scripts.build:github: PUBLIC_SITE_ENV=production SITE_BASE=/inset-site OUT_DIR=dist-github npm run build:site
scripts.preview: npm run build:preview && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler versions upload
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run
